title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot settings Optimize view
summary: The briefing accurately reports the launched roadmap item and the documented Copilot settings controls, without inventing details about the Optimize view. Two minor corrections remain: classify the new landing experience as prepare rather than review, and remove the role-assignment checklist step that has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: The Frontier area concerns preview access.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Frontier program provides eligible organizations preview access to innovative and emerging capabilities in Microsoft 365 before those features reach general availability (GA).

claims.claim: The action rating review fits a new Copilot settings landing experience.
claims.quote: action: "review"; What's changing: "a new Copilot settings landing experience". The scale assigns prepare to a redesign or replacement of existing behaviour even when default state is unknown; review is for optional capabilities or controls.
claims.fix: Change action from review to prepare: this is a new landing experience, not an optional setting that changes nothing until selected.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist tells readers to check has a controls-table row.

claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout bullet beginning 'Confirm who holds the AI Administrator and Global Reader roles'. Keep the supported role descriptions in Scope and Governance controls; do not add a row.
